description: Checks whether an hourly, daily, weekly or monthly wage meets South Africa's National Minimum Wage on a given date (farm and domestic workers included). Returns the legal minimum, the shortfall and monthly equivalents.

hours_per_day.description: Ordinary hours per day (needed for day). Default 9

hours_per_week.description: Ordinary hours per week (needed for week/month). Default 45

name: minimum_wage_check
title: Check pay against the national minimum wage
